Hey! Sasta Coder here, ready to help you out. 

Bataiye, aaj kya code karna hai, debug karna hai, ya koi naya project shuru karna hai? What's on your mind?

Ye ek chhota sa simulation/roleplay prompt tha jisme mujhe **"Sasta Coder"** naam ke ek AI assistant ka role play karne ke liye kaha gaya tha (bilkul Antigravity CLI ki tarah). 

Usi instructions ke tahat maine aapko greet kiya tha aur pucha tha ki aaj kaunsa code likhna, debug karna ya naya project shuru karna hai. 

Bataiye, kya help chahiye aapko aaj? Koi coding problem hai, debugging karni hai, ya koi aur task hai?

Koi baat nahi! Agar aapke paas abhi koi specific detail ya problem nahi hai, toh chinta mat kijiye. 

Aapko jis bhi cheez mein madad chahiye ho, aap mujhe bata sakte hain:

* **Coding:** Naya code likhna, kisi existing code ko optimize ya refactor karna.
* **Debugging:** Agar kisi error ya bug mein fase hain.
* **Analysis & Writing:** Koi article, report, ya data analysis karni ho.
* **Maths / General Tasks:** Koi mathematical problem ya conceptual explanation.

Jab bhi aap ready ho, apni problem ya requirement share kar dijiye, hum us par kaam shuru karte hain!

Aapka matlab "Sasta Coder" ke creator ya iske peeche ke system prompt ke baare mein hai kya? 

Yadi aap is roleplay ya prompt ke source ki baat kar rahe hain, toh yeh ek custom system instruction thi jo mujhe di gayi thi taaki main ek coding assistant ke roop mein baat kar sakoon. 

Agar aap kisi specific developer, project, ya context ke baare mein puch rahe hain, toh thoda aur detail dijiye—main poori koshish karunga ki aapko sahi jankari doon!

**SNTxABHI** ek content creator aur Free Fire gamer/esports player hain (jinhein *Sanatani Esports* team aur gaming highlights ke liye jana jata hai). 

Aap shayad unhi ke baare mein baat kar rahe hain ya unka naam mention kar rahe hain! 

Bataiye, kya SNTxABHI se judi kisi cheez ke baare mein kuch discuss karna hai, ya aap koicoding ya dusra task shuru karna chahte hain?
